denominators.censored_rate: (unresolved entered trades + ambiguous entered trades) / trades
denominators.all_trades_bounds: wins / trades to (wins + unresolved entered trades + ambiguous entered trades) / trades
denominators.expectancy: sum(realized R) / finite resolved R records
denominators.trades: sum(traded=True) when available; otherwise patterns - invalid
denominators.unresolved: All unresolved pattern rows, including no-entry; unresolved_trades excludes no-entry.

bootstrap.autocorrelation_note: Correlation across consecutive active days; inactive days omitted for this diagnostic only.
bootstrap.ess_note: Heuristic min(n, max(1, p*(1-p)/Var_bootstrap(p))); undefined for p=0/1 or zero bootstrap variance. Not an independence guarantee.
bootstrap.dependence_test: Evidence against gross p<=1/3 if bootstrap 95% interval lower endpoint >1/3; descriptive, not an exact null-centered p-value.
